rejected.label: Toxocariasis

rejected.label: Loeffler syndrome
rejected.why: Although the patient had eosinophilia, the overall clinical presentation is more consistent with viral myopericarditis than Loeffler syndrome.

rejected.label: Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection
rejected.why: The negative nasopharyngeal Mycoplasma PCR contradicts this diagnosis despite elevated IgM and IgG levels.
